q: With EBIT of $250m, a 26% tax rate, D&A of $20m, capex of $40m and a $5m increase in NWC, what is UFCF (in $m)?
explain: UFCF = EBIT x (1 - tax rate) + D&A - capex - increase in NWC: NOPAT = 250 x (1 - 26%) = 185; 185 + 20 - 40 - 5 = 160.

sources.title: Unlevered Free Cash Flow (UFCF) | Formula + Calculator
sources.quote: NOPAT = $250 million × (1 – 26%) = $185 million ... Unlevered Free Cash Flow = $185 million + $20 million – $40 million – $5 million = $160 million
